messages:
maria: Heads up — planning to onboard MapperX-4b-lite to the model catalog tomorrow. Need owners for deploy, canary timing, smoke checklist, and a rollback trigger. Who can own the deploy window?
aj: I can own deploy + smoke. Prefer 10:00-11:00 PDT (canary 10:15 start). Plan a small canary (5% traffic) then expand if green.
devon: I’ll own rollback and integration tests. Recommendation: pin v2.1-quant as the default hosting artifact, keep v2.0-fp16 as fallback. Smoke checklist should include health, sample gen, kv cache warm, and p99 latency <= 450ms.
linh: Infra note: we have 2x A10 slots available in that window — I’ll reserve them (canary-ax1 slot). Need confirmation whether autoscale is OK for this model.
ops-bot: Ticket created RDW-3421: mapperx-4b catalog onboarding. Assignees: aj, devon, linh. Link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RDW-3421 
sam: Quick Q — what will the canonical endpoint be? /models/mapperx-4b or /models/mapperx/4b-lite? Need to update SDK tests/docs before canary.
maria: Use /models/mapperx-4b (canonical). I’ll open a docs PR; aj please add a small SDK smoke snippet to the PR.
aj: Adding smoke commands now. Minimal smoke I'll run in order:
1) health check
2) short sample generate (prompt ~200 tokens)
3) embedding sanity for a fixed prompt
4) kv cache warm and repeat latency
Commands:```bash
# health
curl -sS https://api.redwood.example/health | jq .
# sample generate (replace $KEY)
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -d '{"model":"mapperx-4b","input":"Test prompt to validate output"}' | jq .
```
devon: Rollback plan: if errors >5% over 3m OR p99 > 800ms, pin back to v2.0 and drain canary slot. I'll be on-call to trigger rollback. Also: add a runbook step to validate embeddings distance < 0.02 vs staging baseline.
maria: Good. Please add alert rules: model.errors.rate > 5% (3m) and latency.p99 > 800ms to the canary dashboard. Also include an annotation to link the PR + ticket. :thumbsup:
linh: Slot reserved in infra UI (canary-ax1). Note: quantized artifact needs the ff-fast kernel flag; I’ll set kernel=ff-fast in deploy config to avoid kernel fallback perf hit.
aj: I’ll warm caches starting 09:30 PDT (pull weights + run a few long prompts). Can someone approve canary traffic shift when ready? @devon please.
devon: Approved. I’ll run integration tests after the canary expands to 20%. Also will monitor model-specific metrics and tracing.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: mapperx-4b canary start 2024-07-12T17:15:00Z. Canary slot: canary-ax1. Ticket: RDW-3421.
maria: Nice. I’ll post the final checklist + PR link first thing tomorrow. Leave any last blockers here. Thanks, team! :rocket:
